name: lut_client
description: The CONSUMER side of the lut_owner example: a plugin whose pack door reaches the demo.lut type owner by capability NAME through the host funnel. It never sees the lut_owner instance, its vtable, or the table object itself — only the handle entry {type,id,gen,$v}, which it forwards verbatim so the handle can ride packs. Also reports have_cap so the script can degrade when no provider is loaded.
